user_preference: Routine tests may be headless or minimized. Use foreground only when necessary for a user-reported testing issue, bug or regression.
implementation: Both launchers default to headless. Explicit Foreground enables rendered runs; Headless plus Foreground is rejected before launching. Native-only selections refuse a background launch. CMD entry points forward arguments. Production F5 window settings and pinned third-party sources were not edited for this policy.
reason: Pinned GdUnit SceneRunner initializes native scenes by foregrounding the window and warping the actual OS cursor. Minimizing that runner alone cannot provide the requested desktop isolation. A headless display avoids the native desktop surface.

checks.result: Three tests pass; real PowerShell launch plans validate default selectors, explicit omissions/counts, foreground preservation, conflicting modes and native-only refusal without starting Godot.

Actual default headless selection: all sixty cases pass, zero failures/errors/skips. Engine arguments and exact source hashes retained; unchanged 16.67 ms ceilings. Not native-input/render/FPS certification.

Actual headless handler sweep deliberately tightened to 0.01 ms; saved failure and exited 2 without waiting for invisible paused-window interaction. Contract verification, not gameplay performance pass.

references.use: Documented headless display and Dummy audio driver, rather than relying on an unsupported minimized CLI argument.
warp_mouse moves OS cursor; parse_input_event is local engine input.
Inspected isolated pinned framework; foreground/warp calls explain native runner desktop behavior.
